newsitem.title: USA: LaTex Resources Q1 loss widens from 1995.
newsitem.headline: LaTex Resources Q1 loss widens from 1995.

text.p: LaTex Resources Inc said lower oil and gas sales contributed to its loss of $1.2 million in the first quarter ended October 31.

"Hedging losses of $431,238 and lower oil and gas sales resulting from property sales were the chief cause of lower revenues during the quarter," said Jeffrey Wilson, the company's president and chief operating officer.
Wilson added the company had merger-related writedowns of $375,109 in the period.
LaTex posted revenues of $2.9 million in the period, down from $3.5 million one year ago. The $1.2-million loss was higher than the $839,020 loss in the first quarter of 1995.
LaTex is a crude oil and natural gas processing company.
